# ask-widget

> A React chat widget with SSE streaming, custom response handlers, light/dark themes and headless hooks. React and React DOM are peer dependencies. Messages render as plain text.

Package: @chitrank2050/ask-widget. Install with `pnpm add @chitrank2050/ask-widget` and import `@chitrank2050/ask-widget/styles.css`.

## Documentation

- [Documentation index](https://chitranklabs.github.io/ask-widget/llms.txt): Discover guides and reference pages.
- [Full documentation](https://chitranklabs.github.io/ask-widget/llms-full.txt): All documentation as Markdown.
- [Getting started](https://chitranklabs.github.io/ask-widget/getting-started.md): Installation and first integration.
- [Backend and SSE](https://chitranklabs.github.io/ask-widget/backend.md): Keep provider credentials on the server. apiUrl appends /v1/chat; custom handlers support other response formats.
- [Component API](https://chitranklabs.github.io/ask-widget/api.md): Source-generated props and response-handler types.
- [Hooks](https://chitranklabs.github.io/ask-widget/hooks.md): Actual signatures and usage.
- [Theming](https://chitranklabs.github.io/ask-widget/theming.md): CSS variables and host-style considerations.
